description: One mass spectrum, picked by retention time (rt, minutes: the scan nearest it), scan number or zero-based spectrum index: metadata, peaks[] (the most intense, with charge from the isotope spacing and neutral mass) and mz[]/intensity[].

centroid.description: The stored centroid list instead of the profile when a scan has both.

lock_mass.description: Waters .raw: correct m/z with the lock-spray reference scans, given the lock compound's m/z (e.g. 556.2771), or "auto" for the Lock Mass the file records. Default: m/z as stored.

max_points.description: At most this many points, the most intense kept (default 1000; point_count reports the full size).

ms_level.description: Count spectrum among the spectra of this MS level only (1 = full scans, 2 = MS/MS). MS1 and MS/MS scans interleave, and ms_level=2 with spectrum=0 is the first MS/MS scan.

rt.description: The MS scan (of ms_level, default 1) nearest this retention time, minutes: the spectrum at a chromatogram's apex.

run.description: Run index for files with several runs (Sciex samples; default 0).

scan.description: The scan number as the instrument counts it (1-based in Thermo files; mzML `scan=N` native ids, mzXML `num`, timsTOF spectrum position + 1).

spectrum.description: The zero-based spectrum index, counted within ms_level when it is given.

strict.description: Refuse values the file's assurance does not validate (exit_code 6). Default: the server's.

top_peaks.description: Most intense peaks listed under peaks[] with charge and neutral mass (default 20).

name: openreadout_spectrum

MsPeak.description: One of the most intense peaks of a mass spectrum, with its charge from the isotope pattern.

charge.description:
Charge from the spacing of the isotope peaks above it (1.00336/z), when at least one
is found.

isotopes.description: Isotope peaks found in a row above this one at that spacing.

monoisotopic_mz.description:
m/z of the lowest peak of the same isotope pattern (the monoisotopic ion when it is
seen), when it is below this one.

neutral_mass_da.description:
Neutral monoisotopic mass (z · (m/z ∓ proton)), Da, when the charge and polarity are
known.

base_peak_intensity.description: Intensity of the most intense peak.

base_peak_mz.description: m/z of the most intense peak.

centroided.description: True when the peaks are centroids (one point per peak) rather than a sampled profile.

collision_energy.description: Collision energy as recorded (usually eV, or % normalized for Thermo `@hcd35.00`).

extra.description: Format-specific scan metadata in the reader's documented vocabulary.

index.description: Zero-based spectrum index within its run.

intensity.description: Intensity of each point (same length as `mz`).

inverse_reduced_mobility.description: Ion mobility of the precursor or scan, as inverse reduced mobility 1/K0 in V·s/cm².

isolation_window_mz.description: Precursor isolation window `[lower, upper]` in m/z.

ms_level.description: MS level: 1 for a full scan, 2 for a fragment (MS/MS) scan, and so on.

mz.description: Mass-to-charge ratios of the points, ascending.

native_id.description: The spectrum's identifier in its file (mzML `id`, e.g. `controllerType=0 controllerNumber=1 scan=17`).

precursor_charge.description: Charge state of the precursor, when the instrument determined it.

precursor_intensity.description: Intensity of the selected precursor ion, when recorded.

precursor_mz.description: m/z of the precursor ion that was isolated and fragmented (MS2 and above).

rt_s.description:
Retention time in seconds; null when the file states none for this spectrum (never an
invented 0).

scan_filter.description: Instrument scan filter or scan description string (e.g. Thermo `FTMS + p ESI Full ms`).

scan_number.description: Scan number as the instrument counts it (1-based in most formats).

total_ion_current.description: Sum of all intensities in the spectrum (TIC).

format.description: Format id of the input file.

peaks.description: The most intense peaks of the whole spectrum, with charges from their isotope patterns.

point_count.description: Number of points in the full spectrum (the arrays may be shortened by `max_points`).

run.description: Run index the spectrum belongs to.

truncated.description:
True when `mz`/`intensity` were shortened to `max_points` (the most intense points are
kept, in m/z order).

view.description: `primary` (profile when recorded) or `centroid` (the instrument's centroid list).
